ATS keywords to include

Beyond your core skill list, ATS parsers for Software Engineer roles commonly match on:

software development lifecyclescalable systemscode reviewdebuggingagilemicroservices

Sample resume bullet structure

Use these as a starting structure, then replace with your own real numbers and outcomes:

  • Delivered software engineer work using Data Structures & Algorithms and System Design, contributing directly to project/team goals.
  • Applied Git to improve reliability, quality or turnaround time on a real project — quantify this with your own numbers (e.g. "%", "hours saved", "users impacted").
  • Collaborated cross-functionally to ship features/deliverables end-to-end, from requirement to review.

This resume also matches job titles like

SDE · Software Development Engineer · Application Developer

Frequently asked questions

What skills should a Software Engineer resume highlight?

Focus on Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, Git, REST APIs, backed by real projects or work you can speak to in an interview — a skills list alone won't pass a recruiter's second look.

What should a Software Engineer resume highlight?

Lead with measurable impact — systems you built or scaled, latency/throughput improvements, and the languages, frameworks and infra you used in production, not just a skills list.

How many projects should I list?

Two to three strong, detailed projects with metrics beat five shallow ones. For freshers, one solid capstone or internship project plus one personal project is enough.
